-- Reference model: the swapped list, used to state the expected behaviour.
swapped(xs: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex swapped([1, 2, 3]) == [3, 2, 1]
  ex swapped([5]) == [5]
  ex swapped([]) == []
  var r = copy xs
  if r.len() >= 2
    let n = r.len()
    r[0] = xs[n - 1]
    r[n - 1] = xs[0]
  r

-- Swaps the first and last elements of xs in place.
-- Empty and one-element lists are left unchanged.
swap_ends(var xs: List[int]) =
  if xs.len() >= 2
    let n = xs.len()
    let first = xs[0]
    xs[0] = xs[n - 1]
    xs[n - 1] = first
